title: alibertia edulis
intro: Alibertia edulis, commonly known as guanina or guanina branquinho, is a plant species native to the Amazon rainforest in Brazil and Peru. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Alibertia edulis include antimicrobial and antifungal properties, as well as its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant agent, protecting against cell damage and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Alibertia edulis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
